summary: Remove every header and footer reference from every section of each document, and every header/footer part (with its relationships, content-type override and any media nothing else uses); leave page setup, body text and all tracked changes in the body untouched.
assumptions: 'all' means every section, including first-page and even-page variants
section page margins are left as they are (the header/footer space collapses)
titlePg (different first page) and evenAndOddHeaders settings are left as they are
pending tracked changes inside headers/footers are discarded with them and flagged by name

expect.members_removed: header/footer parts and their rels/media not referenced elsewhere
